title: Revision
description: A change activity connecting an old entity version to a new one. Revisions record WHY a change happened; WHICH version is current is recorded in the package manifest, never by editing old files. Old version files are never modified in any way — not even their status field. Supersession is a property of the manifest, not of the superseded file.

id.description: Stable entity identifier in format boe:revision:<ulid>.

entity_id.description: The ID of the entity being revised.

entity_type.description: The type of the entity being revised.

old_version_id.description: The version_id of the entity version being superseded. The old version file is never modified.

new_version_id.description: The version_id of the new entity version created by this revision. The entity 'id' stays the same across both versions.

reason.description: Why this revision was made. Must be specific.

what_changed.description: Description of what specifically changed. For data changes, describe the old value and new value.

triggered_by_review_id.description: If this revision was triggered by a formal challenge or review, the Review entity ID.

approved_by.description: The maintainer or reviewer who approved this revision.

git_commit.description: The Git commit hash where this revision was made.
